name: pinoy-space-gang
description: One-command entry points for the whole repo. The game itself lives in web/ (pnpm) and app/sim/ (npm).

scripts.setup: npx -y pnpm@10 --dir web install --frozen-lockfile && npm --prefix app/sim ci
scripts.check: npx -y pnpm@10 --dir web build && npx -y pnpm@10 --dir web test && npm --prefix app/sim test && npm --prefix app/sim run typecheck && node scripts/catalog/check-consumers.mjs
scripts.preview: npx -y pnpm@10 --dir web build && npx -y pnpm@10 --dir web preview
